The '''Inrokini Stronghold''' was a [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Copero/Legends|Copero]]. During the [[Order of Zildrog campaign]], it produced [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] as well as [[Talon Interceptor]]s.<ref name="TOR:ATAtC" /> In [[3629 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|5.6}}</ref> the [[Alliance Commander|commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]] and [[Raina Temple]] from the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] [[Mission to Copero|defeated]] the [[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] [[Zenta]] and the [[Inrokini family|House Inrokini]] forces in the shipyard.<ref name="TOR:ATAtC" />
